title: NIST Dictionary of Algorithms and Data Structures: feedbackEdgeSet
text:
feedback edge set
feedback edge set
(definition)
Definition:
The smallest
set
of
edges
whose deletion results in an
acyclic graph
.
See also
feedback vertex set
.
